items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of travel-cost reimbursement
items.quote: Halten Sie die Entscheidung für falsch, legen Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids Widerspruch ein – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Beispiel Ersatzkasse.
items.computation: The letter is dated Wed 25 Jun 2025. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a social-insurance letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sun 29 Jun 2025; this day does not shift for the purpose of fixing the delivery date even though it falls on a Sunday. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month objection period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the day after delivery, so counting begins 30 Jun 2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the starting event, i.e. Tue 29 Jul 2025. That day is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). The Widerspruch must reach the Krankenkasse (or another domestic authority/social-insurance carrier) by this date.
